$comment: ERP-neutral functional-entity vocabulary (ADR W7, issue #111). Mappings and DQ rules reference entity_id, never free text — that is what makes two ERPs comparable by construction. Changes are PRs owned by the architecture role; bump `version` on every change. Hard cap: 60 entities. Local additions go in as is_custom entities via loadVocabulary(), never by editing this file ad hoc.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A party the organisation sells to; the account carrying credit, terms and invoicing defaults.

entities.name: Vendor
entities.description: A party the organisation buys from; the account carrying payment terms and remittance defaults.

entities.name: Party
entities.description: The global address-book identity behind a customer, vendor, contact or worker.

entities.name: Address
entities.description: A postal location attached to a party or a document.

entities.name: Contact
entities.description: A communication endpoint (phone, e-mail, URL) attached to a party or address.

entities.name: Item / Product
entities.description: A released product or service that can be stocked, sold, bought or produced.

entities.name: Product variant
entities.description: A configuration/size/colour/style combination of an item.

entities.name: Item category
entities.description: A hierarchy node classifying items for sales, procurement or reporting.

entities.name: Unit of measure
entities.description: A quantity unit and its conversions.

entities.name: Price / trade agreement
entities.description: A sales or purchase price, discount or agreement line.

entities.name: Site
entities.description: An operational location grouping warehouses and production units.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: A physical or logical inventory storage location within a site.

entities.name: Warehouse location
entities.description: A bin, shelf or zone within a warehouse.

entities.name: Legal entity / company
entities.description: The company (data area) that owns the transactions.

entities.name: Number sequence
entities.description: A configured generator of document and master identifiers.

entities.name: Currency
entities.description: A currency code and its exchange rates.

entities.name: Tax code / group
entities.description: A sales-tax code, tax group or item tax group.

entities.name: Payment terms
entities.description: Due-date rules applied to invoices.

entities.name: Delivery terms / mode
entities.description: Incoterms and modes of delivery on orders.

entities.name: Financial dimension
entities.description: An analytical dimension (cost centre, department, business unit) and its values.

entities.name: Sales quotation
entities.description: An offer to a prospect or customer that may become a sales order.

entities.name: Sales order
entities.description: A customer's confirmed request to buy; header level.

entities.name: Sales order line
entities.description: One item, quantity and price on a sales order.

entities.name: Sales agreement
entities.description: A blanket commitment to sell over a period.

entities.name: Shipment / packing slip
entities.description: Goods physically issued against a sales order.

entities.name: Customer invoice
entities.description: A posted sales or free-text invoice; header and lines.

entities.name: Customer payment
entities.description: Cash received from a customer and its settlement.

entities.name: Customer transaction
entities.description: An open or settled sub-ledger posting on a customer account.

entities.name: Return order
entities.description: A customer return (RMA) and its disposition.

entities.name: Purchase requisition
entities.description: An internal request to buy, ahead of a purchase order.

entities.name: Purchase order
entities.description: A confirmed request to a vendor to supply; header level.

entities.name: Purchase order line
entities.description: One item, quantity and price on a purchase order.

entities.name: Purchase agreement
entities.description: A blanket commitment to buy over a period.

entities.name: Product receipt
entities.description: Goods physically received against a purchase order.

entities.name: Vendor invoice
entities.description: A supplier invoice, pending or posted.

entities.name: Vendor payment
entities.description: Cash paid to a vendor and its settlement.

entities.name: Vendor transaction
entities.description: An open or settled sub-ledger posting on a vendor account.

entities.name: Main account
entities.description: A ledger account in the chart of accounts.

entities.name: Ledger journal
entities.description: A general, payment or invoice journal before posting; header and lines.

entities.name: General ledger transaction
entities.description: A posted voucher line in the general ledger.

entities.name: Fiscal calendar / period
entities.description: Fiscal years, periods and their open/closed status.

entities.name: Fixed asset
entities.description: A capitalised asset and its books.

entities.name: Fixed asset transaction
entities.description: Acquisition, depreciation or disposal on an asset book.

entities.name: Bank account
entities.description: A company bank account and its reconciliation.

entities.name: Budget
entities.description: Budget register entries and controls.

entities.name: Project
entities.description: A project, its contract and posting profile.

entities.name: Project transaction
entities.description: Hours, expenses, items or fees posted to a project.

entities.name: Bill of materials / formula
entities.description: The component structure of a produced item; header and lines.

entities.name: Route / operation
entities.description: The operations and resources required to produce an item.

entities.name: Resource / work centre
entities.description: A machine, tool, person or vendor capacity used in production.

entities.name: Production order
entities.description: An order to produce an item; header level.

entities.name: Production order line / BOM consumption
entities.description: Components and operations planned on a production order.

entities.name: Planned order
entities.description: A master-planning proposal to buy, produce or transfer.

entities.name: Inventory on hand
entities.description: Current stock per item and storage dimension.

entities.name: Inventory transaction
entities.description: A physical or financial inventory movement (issue, receipt, transfer, adjustment).

entities.name: Inventory journal
entities.description: Counting, movement, transfer or adjustment journals before posting.

entities.name: Transfer order
entities.description: A movement of stock between warehouses; header and lines.

entities.name: Employee / worker
entities.description: A person employed or contracted by the organisation.

entities.name: Position / job
entities.description: An organisational slot a worker is assigned to.

entities.name: System user
entities.description: A login identity and its security role assignments.
